description: Capture the workspace baseline and validate Codex changes through the existing governance enforcement fabric. Review and trust these hooks before use.

hooks.commandWindows: & { try { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $hookInput = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Repository root unavailable' }; $env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path $root 'src'; $hookInput | & (Join-Path $root '.venv/Scripts/python.exe') -B (Join-Path $root 'scripts/codex_governance_hook.py'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 2 } } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('CODEX_GOVERNANCE_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED'); exit 2 } }
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying repository authority and production instructions
